verdict.rationale: Modal documents running arbitrary commands in Sandboxes through a subprocess-like exec API (e.g. `sb.exec([...])`), a dedicated "Running commands" guide, and a CLI for opening an interactive shell inside a container. Dependencies can be installed via custom images ("any dependency"), and a community report of GitHub Actions runners built on Sandboxes corroborates general command execution. Missing for 10: an explicit example of installing packages at runtime inside a live sandbox (e.g. pip/apt via exec), and independent hands-on corroboration of package installation specifically.
